  [1mIt was never hidden.[0m The [38;5;153mhidden[39m attribute works through a user-agent rule, [38;5;153m[hidden] { display: 
[39m  [38;5;153mnone }[39m, and any explicit [38;5;153mdisplay[39m on the element outranks it. [38;5;153m.dlg[39m sets [38;5;153mdisplay: flex[39m to centre its
  box — so [38;5;153m<div class="dlg" hidden>[39m was fully displayed: a bordered, shadowed, empty box over the   
  terminal that nothing on the page would close. It was empty because there was no prompt to put in 
  it, which is correct behaviour.

  lesson written down beside the code that didn't learn it, third time here.
